title: English Practice Quiz 0475
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: What does 'borrow' mean?
options: take something temporarily and return it
questions.explanation: Borrow means to take something for a period and return it.

questions.question: It ___ rain later; take an umbrella.
Read: 'The meeting was cancelled because the manager was ill.' Why was it cancelled?
questions.explanation: The reason is explicitly stated: the manager was ill.

questions.question: Please ___ the correct answer.
questions.explanation: Choose is the base verb used after please.

questions.question: How ___ apples do you need?
questions.explanation: Apples are countable plural nouns, so use many.

questions.question: He is ___ honest man.
questions.explanation: Use an before a vowel sound. Honest begins with a silent h.

questions.question: A person you can trust is ___.
You look tired. You ___ get some rest.
Read: 'Ravi practises English for twenty minutes every evening.' How long does he practise?
The weather can ___ your travel plans.
questions.explanation: Affect is usually a verb meaning to influence.
